title: Empirical Evaluation of Knowledge Distillation from Transformers to Subquadratic Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical efficiency of distilling Transformer-based knowledge into subquadratic architectures like xLSTM and SSMs. It evaluates models on standard NLP benchmarks (LAMBADA, PIQA, ARC, etc.) and long-context tasks but does not involve benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
